In detail

South Yorkshire Police recorded 832 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 13.4 per 1,000 residents, the 5th highest rate of Sheffield's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (11), burglary (9), drugs (7); the evening/night score by violent crime (109), anti social behaviour (44), public order (19). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Southey safe?

Wandroz currently rates Southey in Sheffield as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Sheffield during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Sheffield at night. This rating is derived from South Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Southey safe at night?

At night, Southey is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Sheffield. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Southey a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Southey's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Sheffield) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
